title: HOLO✦PAD
problem: Making 3D experiences more accessible through the browser.
solution: A browser-native spatial computing platform exploring AI-assisted 2D-to-3D conversion and interactive digital environments.
keyDecisions: Use WebGL and Three.js for real-time browser rendering rather than a desktop-only engine.
Explore AI-based segmentation and depth estimation to assist image-to-3D workflows.
Build around browser accessibility rather than requiring a dedicated headset.

outcome.after: Working prototype + public project repository (performance and user outcomes pending validation).

title: Saathi / Samvaad
problem: Students may need accessible, multilingual conversational support in college environments.
solution: A multilingual chatbot concept designed for college settings, with a retrieval and language-model pipeline to ground responses in relevant information.
keyDecisions: Explore retrieval-based responses rather than relying entirely on free-form generation.
Separate retrieval, language understanding, and response generation into distinct stages.

outcome.after: Project concept and architecture documented. Deployment, institutional adoption, and user-impact numbers remain unverified.
